newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's BBV gains on better Q1 forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Spain's BBV gains on better Q1 forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya were strongly higher on Wednesday as analysts revised up first quarter results forecasts, dealers said.
At 1420 GMT BBV was up 110 pesetas, 1.26 percent, to 8,850 while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares was down 0.4 percent to 5,563.77.
A Reuters poll today found that analysts were on average expecting a 24.2 percent rise in first quarter attributable profit to 24.61 billion pesetas versus 19.81 this time last year.
"A few weeks ago everyone was expecting an around 20 percent rise in earnings, but now the forecasts have been revised up. Everyone is buying," said a dealer at a foreign brokerage.
BBV is due to publish results on Thursday.
